item.title: wdrop 1.3.0
item.description:
新增

  • Agent 接入可一键配置、逐个授权读写并撤销会话权限

Added

  • Configure MCP clients in one click, authorize agents individually, and revoke access for active sessions

item.title: wdrop 1.2.5
item.description:
改进

  • 管理窗口列表显示剪贴板图片时占用更少内存
  • 预览含多种格式的图片和富文本时占用更少内存
  • 底部栏显示大量长文本时占用更少内存

修复

  • 编辑卡片开着时，点击底部栏以外区域不再无法收起底部栏
  • 管理窗口的文字卡片不再把组合表情算成多个字

Changed

  • The management window uses less memory when listing clipboard images
  • Image and rich text previews use less memory when items contain multiple formats
  • The Sheet uses less memory when showing many long text entries

Fixed

  • The Sheet now closes on outside clicks while an edit card is open
  • Text cards in the management window count each combined emoji as one character

item.title: wdrop 1.2.4
item.description:
改进

  • 查看改为独立窗口，支持图片缩放、平移和文字选择

修复

  • 运行中的应用不再显示旧图标
  • 反复查看图片后，内存占用不再持续增加

Changed

  • View items in an independent window with image zoom, pan, and text selection

Fixed

  • The running app no longer shows an outdated icon
  • Repeated image previews no longer keep increasing memory use
